## Antec EARTHWATTS GOLD PRO 750 750W 

 Form Factor ATX Efficiency Rating 80+ Gold Wattage 750 W Length 140 mm Modular Semi 

The Antec EARTHWATTS GOLD PRO 750 is an ATX form factor power supply designed to deliver a maximum output of 750W. It achieves an 80+ Gold efficiency rating, ensuring that it operates efficiently under load, reducing energy waste and heat generation. The unit has a compact length of 140 mm, making it suitable for a variety of case sizes without compromising on power delivery.

This power supply features a semi-modular design, providing flexibility in cable management while maintaining a simplified approach to the non-modular aspects. It lacks fanless capability, meaning it relies on active cooling for thermal management. Connectivity options include two EPS connectors to support CPU power requirements and four PCIe 6+2-Pin connectors, accommodating multiple GPUs. Additionally, it features eight SATA connectors and three Molex 4-Pin connectors, allowing for broad compatibility with modern and legacy components.

The absence of PCIe 12-Pin and 12+4-Pin connectors may limit compatibility with the latest high-powered graphics cards, which can affect system performance for users requiring advanced graphics capabilities. Overall, the Antec EARTHWATTS GOLD PRO 750 is positioned as a strong choice for mid-range builds, providing a solid blend of performance, efficiency, and modularity.
